verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any project or organization isolation pattern, such as folders, org policies, sandbox projects or prod/non-prod separation guardrails. IAM permissions, budgets and the local Firestore emulator are adjacent controls, not documented multi-project isolation patterns. The APIs Explorer docs explicitly say it acts on real data with no sandboxed mode.

support.subject: As a developer, experiments cannot hurt prod — documented multi-account/project isolation patterns (org units, sandboxes) with guardrails
